title: 第341章 战力提升
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“这下安静多了。”赵子寒右手一扬将宝剑收了回来，满脸惬意地长舒了一口气。

随后再次盘膝坐下，取出两块灵石捏在手中。

也就在这一瞬间，忽然一道绿光破空而至，赵子寒神色一惊地从地上跳了起来。

但他的双脚已被一根手腕处粗的绿绳死死缠住，才刚跳起来，就感觉脚下被人拉了一把，重新掉回地面。

远处的韩林见状，心中一喜，右手并指一挥，那绿色绳索顿时如同灵蛇一般，向着赵子寒上半身缠去！顷刻间，就将赵子寒缠了个结结实实。

“青木索！”

赵子寒面色一变，惊叫起来：“赵原哥救我！”

另一座巨石上的赵原见到此景，脸色大变，呼的一下从地上弹跳起来。

“何方道友躲在暗处，还不现身一见！”

“我来也！”

赵原话音刚落，突然一个头戴斗笠的银袍男子，脚踩一把阔剑从远处破空而来。

同时翻手一掌，幻化出一个巨大的金色掌印，朝着赵原狠狠砸去。

“筑基初期？”

此人一出手，赵原就看穿了此人的修为，“好大的狗胆，区区初期也敢躲在暗中偷袭。”

说着，他一闪避开袭来的掌印，五指虚抓一把，只见浮现出五颗红彤彤的火球，狠狠朝对面的斗笠男子砸了过去。

斗笠男子见状，脚底飞剑突然一转，就飞向了另一边，“赵原，你就这点本事么！”

“小子，你休要猖狂，今天定叫你知道老夫的厉害。”赵原怒喝一声，单手掐诀对着斗笠男子遥遥一指，顿时无数火红色剑影，仿佛蝗虫过境般呼啸而出。

“老儿有点本事，爷爷暂避锋芒！”斗笠男子惊叫一声，甩出一块银色盾牌挡在身后，唰的呼的一声就朝远处飞去。

“休走！”

赵原沉声一喝，脚踩一把飞剑紧随其后。

“别追！”

赵子寒见状神色一变，大声叫喊。

话音刚落，他身上的青木索就忽然猛地一收，将他缠得死死的！同时青木索的另一端，生出无数根须，死死黏在巨石表面，让他想逃也逃不了。

“果然还有人。”当发现身上的异常，赵子寒更加确定，刚才离开那人只是个幌子而已。

急忙全力调动真元，释放出一股无形的力量，将缠在身上的青木索撑得嚓嚓作响。

而就在这一瞬间，一抹百丈刀光，忽然从他对面的几块巨石中间升了起来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"It's much quieter now." Zhao Zihan raised his right hand and took back the sword, and let out a long sigh of relief.

Then he sat cross-legged again, took out two spiritual stones and held them in his hands.

At this moment, a green light suddenly shot through the air, and Zhao Zihan jumped up from the ground with a startled expression.

But his feet were already tightly entangled with a thick green rope at his wrists. As soon as he jumped up, he felt someone pulled at his feet and fell back to the ground.

Seeing this, Han Lin in the distance felt happy. He waved his right hands together, and the green rope immediately wrapped around Zhao Zihan's upper body like a snake!In an instant, Zhao Zihan was entangled tightly.

"Aokisuo!"

Zhao Zihan's expression changed and he screamed: "Brother Zhao Yuan, save me!"

Zhao Yuan, who was standing on another boulder, saw this scene, his face changed drastically, and he jumped up from the ground with a cry.

"Where is the fellow Taoist who is hiding in the dark and yet you don't show up to see me!"

"I'm coming too!"

As soon as Zhao Yuan finished speaking, a man in silver robe wearing a bamboo hat suddenly came from a distance with a broad sword at his feet.

At the same time, he turned his hand and transformed into a huge golden palm print, hitting Zhao Yuan hard.

"Early stage of foundation building?"

As soon as this person made a move, Zhao Yuan saw through this person's cultivation level, "What a courageous person. He dared to hide in the dark and attack in the early stages."

As he spoke, he dodged the incoming palm print, grabbed it with his fingers, and saw five red fireballs emerging, and they smashed towards the man in the bamboo hat opposite.

Seeing this, the man in the bamboo hat suddenly turned the flying sword under his feet and flew to the other side, "Zhao Yuan, is this all you have?"

"Boy, don't be so arrogant. Today I will show you how powerful I am." Zhao Yuan shouted angrily and pointed at the man in the bamboo hat with one hand. Suddenly, countless fiery red sword shadows whizzed out like locusts passing through.

"I have some skills, Grandpa, please stay away from the edge for now!" The man in the bamboo hat screamed, threw out a silver shield behind him, and flew away with a whoosh.

"Don't leave!"

Zhao Yuan shouted in a deep voice and followed closely with a flying sword under his feet.

"Don't chase!"

When Zhao Zihan saw this, his expression changed and he shouted loudly.

As soon as he finished speaking, the green wooden rope on his body suddenly retracted and entangled him tightly!At the same time, countless roots sprouted from the other end of the green wooden rope, clinging to the surface of the boulder, making it impossible for him to escape even if he wanted to.

"Sure enough, there is still someone." When he discovered something strange about him, Zhao Zihan became even more sure that leaving the person just now was just a pretense.

He hurriedly mobilized his true energy with all his strength and released an invisible force, which made the green wood rope wrapped around his body make a crunching sound.

And at this moment, a light of a hundred-foot sword suddenly rose from the middle of several boulders opposite him.
